feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Canada claps back at Trump's efforts to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America'
entry.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has unveiled a giant billboard reading: "Lake Ontario — Now and Always." But tech giant Google has said it is renaming the lake for U.S. users, as President Trump demanded.

entry.title: Energy experts have doubts about Trump's newly proposed Venezuelan oil deal
entry.summary: There are many reasons to be skeptical of the Trump administration's announcement that the U.S. will develop Venezuelan oil.

entry.title: From Appalachia to Africa: Why Dolly Parton was beloved across the continent
entry.summary: Dolly Parton's songs traveled far beyond Nashville. Across Africa, musicians embraced her stories of hardship, heartbreak and humble beginnings — and made them their own.

entry.title: Nepal warns of possible fresh flooding as communities grapple with devastation
entry.summary: Authorities in Nepal warned of possible fresh flooding on Sunday and urged residents in flood-affected districts to remain on high alert after water levels rose in the Bhotekoshi River.

entry.title: Icelanders vote 'no' to talks aimed at joining the EU in close referendum
entry.summary: The vote against the EU led by 52.8 percent with nearly all votes counted, according to RÚV, Iceland's broadcaster.

entry.title: Getting help to Nepal's flood survivors is proving difficult
entry.summary: Blocked roads and monsoon weather are complicating efforts to get food, shelter and emergency hygeine to survivors of Nepal's catastrophic floods. World Vision's Dhruba Gurmachhan explains what survivors need the most.

entry.title: Rescuers race to find thousands missing after deadly Himalayan floods
entry.summary: Rescue crews are struggling through blocked roads, high mountain canyons and dangerous terrain as they search for thousands of people missing in Nepal and Tibet.

entry.title: Russian strike near Kyiv kills 37, in one of the year's deadliest attacks
entry.summary: The deadly strike comes amid 72 hours of near constant drone strikes across Ukraine, severely disrupting daily life.

entry.title: Photos: See the aftermath of deadly flash floods in Nepal
entry.summary: Nepal officials say the death toll has continues to rise in Wednesday's floods that washed away communities in Nepal and Tibet, which is held by China. About 2,500 people are missing in both areas.

entry.title: Srebrenica survivor Ahmed Hrustanovic reflects on Ratko Mladic's death
entry.summary: Ahmed Hrustanovic reflects on Ratko Mladic's death with NPR's Scott Simon. All of Hrustanovic's adult male relatives died in the Srebrenica Massacre engineered by Mladic.
